name: Plasma
notes: Default: the official plasma-symbol-dark.svg (#141414), path unchanged, placed on the 64 grid. The kit also ships the symbol in white and boxed on #162F29, so the base is the standalone symbol (base icon background rule)
Mono: the same symbol in currentColor
Square: the official plasma-boxed.svg (the white symbol on a full-bleed #162F29 square), scaled 64/166
Circle: the official XPL token mark token/xpl-mark.svg (the white symbol on a #162F29 disc), scaled 64/240
SquareMono and CircleMono: the square or disc in currentColor with the symbol knocked out (mask)
brandColor: #162F29, the colour of the official boxed logo and token (the standalone symbol is the neutral #141414)
